summary: Polygon's Nicole Clark curates 35 of the best couch co-op games for Nintendo Switch, split into games for two players and games for two or more. Picks range from farming sims and puzzle games to platformers, brawlers and party games. The author prefers local multiplayer because friends can revive her character and shared chaos or building is more fun than dying alone. The latest update added Escape Academy.
one_line: Polygon's curated list of 35 Nintendo Switch games with local co-op, from Stardew Valley and Portal to Mario Kart and Super Smash Bros.
key_facts: The list is Polygon's What to Play pick of 35 best couch co-op games for Nintendo Switch, written by Nicole Clark and published October 20, 2023.
The most recent update to the list added Escape Academy.
Stardew Valley supports local co-op for two players (up to four online), and players should build an extra cabin on the farm.
Portal and Portal 2 on Switch are in one remaster, and local co-op doubles the number of portals that can be placed.
In Spiritfarer, player two controls Stella's cat Daffodil, who can do most management sim tasks but cannot talk to characters or trigger quests.
In Luigi's Mansion 3, player two plays as Gooigi after the intro walkthrough and getting E. Gadd's briefcase.
Mario + Rabbids local co-op is limited to five specific challenges, so Polygon doesn't recommend buying it just for co-op.
Super Mario Bros. Wonder allows four-player local multiplayer with characters including Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Princess Daisy, Toad and Toadette.
The Lego Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga has Lego versions of nine movies and over 200 minifigs to unlock.
Spelunky 2 lets players revive a dead partner by finding a coffin, with ragdoll physics and turkey riding.
Super Smash Bros. on Switch supports up to seven other players, for eight total.
Mario Kart, a 20-year series, came out in 2017 on Switch and recently added Mario Kart 7's Rainbow Road.
In the spaceship game, each player can pilot only one of the ship's eight control panels at a time.
TMNT: Shredder's Revenge lets players choose from Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, Raphael, April O'Neil, Master Splinter or Casey Jones.
